name: Half Dome
description: A monumental pale granite mountain shaped like a dome sliced vertically in half. One face is a huge sheer smooth cliff, while the back is a rounded sloping shoulder. Dark vertical weathering streaks mark the rock. Smaller granite ridges and a forest of tiny evergreen trees surround it, beneath clear blue mountain sky.
